title: Income cutoff and subsidy program participation

llm_response.content:
## 1. Identification Strategy
- Method: Sharp Regression Discontinuity Design (RDD).
- Why: Eligibility for the subsidy changes discontinuously at the known cutoff of the running variable (income/threshold ratio at 0.5). Comparing observations infinitesimally below vs. above the cutoff identifies the local average treatment effect of eligibility on housing expenditure share.
- Key assumptions:
  - Continuity: In the absence of treatment, the conditional expectation of housing expenditure share y as a function of the running variable would be continuous at the cutoff.
  - No precise manipulation: Households cannot precisely sort/manipulate income around the cutoff. We test this with a McCrary density test.
  - Locality: The treatment effect is identified locally at the cutoff; specification uses local linear (and quadratic as a robustness) with triangular kernel.

## 2. R Code
```r
# Self-contained R code to implement a sharp RDD with manipulation check and robustness
# Path: experiments/exp_b/data/s27_data.csv

# ---- Setup and data ----
path <- "experiments/exp_b/data/s27_data.csv"
dat <- read.csv(path)

# Coerce types
dat$running_var  <- as.numeric(dat$running_var)
dat$treated      <- as.integer(dat$treated)
dat$y            <- as.numeric(dat$y)
dat$near_cutoff  <- as.integer(dat$near_cutoff)

# Define cutoff and compute treatment from running variable (for sharp RD)
c0 <- 0.5
dat$treat_calc <- as.integer(dat$running_var <= c0)

# Check whether provided 'treated' matches the mechanical sharp-RD assignment
misclass_rate <- mean(dat$treated != dat$treat_calc, na.rm = TRUE)
cat("Share of treatment misclassification (provided vs computed):", round(misclass_rate, 3), "\n")
# For RD, we will use treat_calc by design.

# ---- Helper: local linear/quadratic RD with triangular kernel ----
local_linear_rd <- function(y, x, c=0, h=0.1, p=1, kernel="triangular") {
  x_c <- x - c
  z   <- as.integer(x_c <= 0)
  # Triangular kernel weights within bandwidth
  if (kernel == "triangular") {
    w <- pmax(0, 1 - abs(x_c)/h)
  } else if (kernel == "uniform") {
    w <- as.numeric(abs(x_c) <= h)
  } else {
    stop("Unsupported kernel.")
  }
  sel <- (w > 0) & is.finite(y) & is.finite(x_c)
  if (sum(sel) < 30) stop("Not enough observations within bandwidth.")
  df <- data.frame(y=y[sel], z=z[sel], x=x_c[sel])
  w  <- w[sel]
  if (p == 1) {
    fit <- lm(y ~ z + x + z:x, data=df, weights=w)
  } else if (p == 2) {
    df$x2 <- df$x^2
    fit <- lm(y ~ z + x + x2 + z:x + z:x2, data=df, weights=w)
  } else {
    stop("p must be 1 or 2.")
  }
  co <- summary(fit)$coef
  est  <- co["z","Estimate"]
  se   <- co["z","Std. Error"]
  tval <- est/se
  pval <- 2*pt(-abs(tval), df = summary(fit)$df[2])
  list(est=est, se=se, t=tval, p=pval, n=sum(sel), h=h, p=p)
}

# ---- Main RD estimate (local linear, triangular, h=0.10) ----
set.seed(123)
main_h <- 0.10
main <- local_linear_rd(dat$y, dat$running_var, c=c0, h=main_h, p=1, kernel="triangular")
cat("Main local linear RD estimate (triangular, p=1) at cutoff", c0, "\n")
cat("tau_hat =", round(main$est, 4), 
    "SE =", round(main$se, 4), 
    "p =", signif(main$p, 3), 
    "N_in_bw =", main$n, 
    "h =", main$h, "\n")

# ---- Attempt to use rdrobust (if available) for RBC inference ----
if (!requireNamespace("rdrobust", quietly = TRUE)) {
  try(suppressWarnings(install.packages("rdrobust", repos="https://cloud.r-project.org")), silent=TRUE)
}
if (requireNamespace("rdrobust", quietly = TRUE)) {
  cat("\nrdrobust results (bias-corrected/robust inference):\n")
  rd <- rdrobust::rdrobust(y = dat$y, x = dat$running_var, c = c0, p = 1, kernel = "triangular")
  # Print a compact summary
  print(summary(rd))
  # Best-effort extraction of point estimate and SE (bias-corrected if available)
  est_rd <- tryCatch(rd$coef[1], error=function(e) NA_real_)
  se_rd  <- tryCatch(rd$se[1],   error=function(e) NA_real_)
  if (is.finite(est_rd)) {
    cat("rdrobust point estimate (tau):", round(est_rd, 4), 
        "SE:", round(se_rd, 4), "\n")
  }
}

# ---- McCrary density test (manipulation at cutoff) ----
mccrary_fallback <- function(x, c=0.5, H=0.2, binwidth=0.02) {
  left  <- x[x >= c - H & x <  c]
  right <- x[x >  c       & x <= c + H]
  # Left bins
  breaks_left <- seq(c - H, c, by=binwidth)
  if (tail(breaks_left,1) < c) breaks_left <- c(breaks_left, c)
  mids_left   <- head(breaks_left, -1) + binwidth/2
  counts_left <- as.numeric(table(cut(left, breaks=breaks_left, include.lowest=TRUE, right=FALSE)))
  dens_left   <- log((counts_left + 0.5)/binwidth)
  dist_left   <- mids_left - c
  fit_left    <- lm(dens_left ~ dist_left)
  se_left     <- sqrt(vcov(fit_left)[1,1])
  int_left    <- coef(fit_left)[1]
  # Right bins
  breaks_right <- seq(c, c + H, by=binwidth)
  if (tail(breaks_right,1) < c + H) breaks_right <- c(breaks_right, c + H)
  mids_right   <- head(breaks_right, -1) + binwidth/2
  counts_right <- as.numeric(table(cut(right, breaks=breaks_right, include_lowest=FALSE, right=TRUE)))
  dens_right   <- log((counts_right + 0.5)/binwidth)
  dist_right   <- mids_right - c
  fit_right    <- lm(dens_right ~ dist_right)
  se_right     <- sqrt(vcov(fit_right)[1,1])
  int_right    <- coef(fit_right)[1]
  diff   <- int_right - int_left
  seDiff <- sqrt(se_left^2 + se_right^2)
  z      <- diff / seDiff
  p      <- 2*pnorm(-abs(z))
  list(diff_log_density=diff, z=z, p=p, H=H, binwidth=binwidth)
}

cat("\nMcCrary (density discontinuity) test at cutoff", c0, ":\n")
dens_done <- FALSE
if (!requireNamespace("rddensity", quietly = TRUE)) {
  try(suppressWarnings(install.packages("rddensity", repos="https://cloud.r-project.org")), silent=TRUE)
}
if (requireNamespace("rddensity", quietly = TRUE)) {
  # Use rddensity if available
  dd <- rddensity::rddensity(dat$running_var, c = c0)
  cat("rddensity summary:\n")
  print(summary(dd))
  dens_done <- TRUE
}
# Fallback McCrary-style test if needed
if (!dens_done) {
  mc <- mccrary_fallback(dat$running_var, c=c0, H=0.2, binwidth=0.02)
  cat("Fallback log-density jump (right-left):", round(mc$diff_log_density, 4), 
      "z =", round(mc$z, 3), 
      "p =", signif(mc$p, 3), 
      "(H=0.2, binwidth=0.02)\n")
}

# ---- Robustness checks ----
cat("\nRobustness: alternative bandwidths (p=1)\n")
for (hh in c(0.05, 0.20)) {
  rb <- local_linear_rd(dat$y, dat$running_var, c=c0, h=hh, p=1, kernel="triangular")
  cat("h =", format(hh, nsmall=2), 
      "tau_hat =", round(rb$est, 4), 
      "SE =", round(rb$se, 4), 
      "p =", signif(rb$p, 3), 
      "N_in_bw =", rb$n, "\n")
}

cat("\nRobustness: quadratic specification (p=2), h=0.10\n")
quad <- local_linear_rd(dat$y, dat$running_var, c=c0, h=0.10, p=2, kernel="triangular")
cat("p=2 tau_hat =", round(quad$est, 4), 
    "SE =", round(quad$se, 4), 
    "p =", signif(quad$p, 3), 
    "N_in_bw =", quad$n, "\n")

# Local randomization style: narrow symmetric windows (unweighted diff-in-means)
dr_test <- function(data, w) {
  sel <- abs(data$running_var - c0) <= w
  tL  <- data$treat_calc[sel] == 1
  tR  <- data$treat_calc[sel] == 0
  if (sum(tL) < 10 || sum(tR) < 10) return(NULL)
  tt <- t.test(data$y[sel & data$treat_calc==1], data$y[sel & data$treat_calc==0])
  list(w=w, diff=diff(rev(tt$estimate)), p=tt$p.value, n=sum(sel))
}
cat("\nRobustness: local randomization (diff-in-means) in narrow windows\n")
for (w in c(0.05, 0.10)) {
  out <- dr_test(dat, w)
  if (!is.null(out)) {
    cat("Window |x-c| <=", out$w, 
        "Diff (T-C) =", round(out$diff, 4), 
        "p =", signif(out$p, 3), 
        "N =", out$n, "\n")
  } else {
    cat("Window |x-c| <=", w, ": insufficient data on one side.\n")
  }
}

# Use provided near_cutoff flag as an additional local comparison
cat("\nRobustness: within provided near_cutoff==1 sample (OLS with side-specific slopes)\n")
near <- subset(dat, near_cutoff == 1)
if (nrow(near) >= 30) {
  x_c <- near$running_var - c0
  z   <- as.integer(x_c <= 0)
  fit_near <- lm(y ~ z + x_c + z:x_c, data=data.frame(y=near$y, z=z, x_c=x_c))
  co_near  <- summary(fit_near)$coef
  if ("z" %in% rownames(co_near)) {
    cat("tau_hat (near_cutoff==1) =", round(co_near["z","Estimate"], 4), 
        "SE =", round(co_near["z","Std. Error"], 4),
        "p =", signif(2*pt(-abs(co_near["z","t value"]), df=summary(fit_near)$df[2]), 3),
        "N =", nrow(near), "\n")
  }
} else {
  cat("Not enough observations with near_cutoff==1.\n")
}

# ---- Final printed result (main estimate) ----
cat("\nFINAL: Sharp RD effect of eligibility on housing expenditure share at cutoff", c0, "\n")
cat("tau_hat =", round(main$est, 4), "with SE =", round(main$se, 4), 
    "and p-value =", signif(main$p, 3), 
    "(local linear, triangular kernel, h =", main$h, ")\n")
```

## 3. Expected Findings
- Sign: I expect a negative discontinuity in the housing expenditure share at eligibility (i.e., eligible households spend a smaller share of their budget out-of-pocket on housing). A subsidy lowers the effective price of housing; while households may upgrade housing quality (substitution toward housing), the out-of-pocket expenditure share typically falls or does not rise, especially near the cutoff where treatment intensity is moderate.
- Magnitude: A local effect of roughly −0.02 to −0.05 (2–5 percentage points) in the housing expenditure share is plausible near the cutoff, with standard errors around 0.01–0.02 depending on bandwidth and smoothness. Robustness checks (alternative bandwidths and quadratic specification) should show similar sign and comparable magnitude if assumptions hold.

_ground_truth.identification_strategy: Sharp RDD — income cutoff; test for manipulation; local linear; optimal bandwidth (IK or CCT)
_ground_truth.conclusion_detail: Eligible households increase housing expenditure share
_ground_truth.main_effect: ~25pp increase in housing spend for eligible households
